source.citation: Königsberger, M., Pichler, B., Hellmich, C. (2014). Micromechanics of ITZ-Aggregate Interaction in Concrete Part II: Strength Upscaling. Journal of the American Ceramic Society 97, 543-551.

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Sections II-IV, pp. 3-6, read on the page images
transcription.note: Results for the typical concrete of the companion Part I (konigsberger2014stress.json). The text layer of the PDF drops the minus signs of Eqs. (9), (14) and of Bvol - Bdev; they are read on the page images.

Bvol_minus_Bdev.description: Difference of the spherical and deviatoric traction concentration factors on the aggregate surface.

sep_uniaxial_compression.description: Uniaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ-aggregate separation, in units of the separation strength.

sep_uniaxial_tension.description: Uniaxial tensile elastic limit for ITZ-aggregate separation, in units of the separation strength.

theta_tension.description: Zenith angle, in units of pi, where ITZ failure starts under uniaxial tension.

theta_compression.description: Zenith angle, in units of pi, where ITZ failure starts under uniaxial compression.

itz_peak_tension.description: Largest principal ITZ stress per unit uniaxial tensile macrostress.

itz_peak_compression.description: Largest principal ITZ stress per unit uniaxial macrostress, under compression (the stress is positive, the macrostress negative).

itz_uniaxial_tension.description: Uniaxial tensile elastic limit for ITZ failure, in units of the ITZ tensile strength.

itz_uniaxial_compression.description: Uniaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ failure, in units of the ITZ tensile strength.

sep_biaxial_compression.description: Symmetric biaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ-aggregate separation, in units of the separation strength.

itz_biaxial_compression.description: Symmetric biaxial compressive elastic limit for ITZ failure, in units of the ITZ tensile strength.

crack_angle_tension.description: Angle, in units of pi, between the loading axis and the direction of the largest principal ITZ stress where ITZ failure starts under uniaxial tension: the normal of the first ITZ crack.

crack_angle_compression.description: Angle, in units of pi, between the loading axis and the direction of the largest principal ITZ stress where ITZ failure starts under uniaxial compression: the normal of the first ITZ crack.

theta_biaxial_compression.description: Zenith angle, measured from the axis normal to the loading plane, where ITZ failure starts under symmetric biaxial compression.

ratio_ut_uc_separation.description: Ratio of the uniaxial tensile to the absolute uniaxial compressive elastic limit when separation governs both.

ratio_ut_uc_mixed_slope.description: Slope, with respect to the strength ratio T_ult/sigma_ult_ITZ, of the tensile-to-compressive elastic limit ratio when separation governs tension and ITZ failure compression.

ratio_ut_uc_itz.description: Ratio of the uniaxial tensile to the absolute uniaxial compressive elastic limit when ITZ failure governs both.

ratio_ut_uc_bound_low.description: Strength ratio T_ult/sigma_ult_ITZ above which ITZ failure governs uniaxial compression.

ratio_ut_uc_bound_high.description: Strength ratio T_ult/sigma_ult_ITZ above which ITZ failure also governs uniaxial tension.

ratio_bc_uc_separation.description: Ratio of the symmetric biaxial to the uniaxial compressive elastic limit when separation governs both.

ratio_bc_uc_mixed_slope.description: Slope, with respect to the strength ratio T_ult/sigma_ult_ITZ, of the biaxial-to-uniaxial compressive elastic limit ratio when separation governs biaxial and ITZ failure uniaxial compression.

ratio_bc_uc_itz.description: Ratio of the symmetric biaxial to the uniaxial compressive elastic limit when ITZ failure governs both.

ratio_bc_uc_bound_low.description: Strength ratio T_ult/sigma_ult_ITZ above which ITZ failure governs uniaxial compression.

ratio_bc_uc_bound_high.description: Strength ratio T_ult/sigma_ult_ITZ above which ITZ failure also governs symmetric biaxial compression.

experimental_ratio_ut_uc_min.description: Lower end of the experimental range of the tensile-to-compressive elastic limit ratio, built from elastic-limit-to-strength ratios and the tensile-to-compressive strength ratio of the literature.

experimental_ratio_ut_uc_max.description: Upper end of the experimental range of the tensile-to-compressive elastic limit ratio.

experimental_ratio_bc_uc_min.description: Lower end of the experimental range of the biaxial-to-uniaxial compressive elastic limit ratio, built from the tests of Kupfer et al. (1969).

experimental_ratio_bc_uc_max.description: Upper end of the experimental range of the biaxial-to-uniaxial compressive elastic limit ratio.
